title: Otori Emu — Fishing Before The Storm〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Tsukasa! Rui!
We're done cleaning up over here!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We're just about done as well, so we can call it a day after we get changed.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Good work, everyone.
If we keep this up, we should be more than ready for our ambassadorial performance.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah.
Not only that, we get to do it in Okinawa...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's right. It'll be the furthest we've ever traveled for one of these shows.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehe. I can't wait☆
And we get to go on Shosuke's cruiser♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me! He also told me to ask you guys about something!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hm? Does it have to do with our ambassadorial performance?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So, it has to do with what we can do while we're on his cruiser. He said that we'll have time to stop somewhere for a few hours to play in the ocean, and he told me to ask how you guys would feel about that!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, he's letting us do that?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see... Doing that after we've put on our show seems fine, but before...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It may not be easy for us to practice while we're aboard the cruiser, so we could take that opportunity to relax a little before our show, no?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, that's also true.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Woohoo! What do you guys wanna do?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, I already asked if we can try doing some water skiing♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Water skiing?
As in being towed by a boat while wearing skis?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, that sounds incredibly fun!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I know, right?!
But he said that we couldn't because we might get hurt!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
We can't?!
To be fair, we probably shouldn't take too many risks before our show...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But he said he'd be okay with looking for an instructor after we do our show!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That sounds really scary. I think I'll be okay with just watching...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Also, what happened to coming up with things to do while we're aboard the cruiser?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehe. Oh, right...
So, what do you guys wanna do?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Since we'll be out on the water, I'd like to do some fishing!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm not sure what I want to do yet...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It's gonna be warm and I might get sunburnt, so I might just relax inside the cabin since it should be nice and cool.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I think I'll get in some reading.
It'll be wonderful to do so while getting a taste of the sea breeze.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And I'll be more than satisfied as long as I get to see Tsukasa and the rest of you battle it out with the fishes...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hahaha! Alright, I'll just have to catch something so big that it leaves you completely speechless!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hm? Something so big...?
Like the Earth?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ugh...
Are you insinuating that I'm going to get my hook caught on some corals or rocks below the surface?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That and an old boot to complete the picture.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Grr... Again with the mockery!
Just you wait! I'll catch me some snappers, tuna, shrimp, flounders or what have you!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Why shrimp?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, they'll be nice and plump.
Really yummy too if we grill or fry them right there♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Also, Tsukasa, you seem awfully confident in your abilities. Have you fished before in the past?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Down by a river when I was little.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wait, that's it?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? What of it?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That makes you a total novice...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Heh. I may be a total novice...
However, my victory is assured!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Because I have beginner's luck on my side!!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Which means your success is based on pure chance.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Haha! That's so cool, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, there's just no way. If dumb luck alone lets you catch snappers and tuna, then you'd be bringing the fishing industry to its knees.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hahaha! Say these things while you can! I'll show you all when we're aboard the cruiser!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, I'll be looking forward to that.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Then, fishing it is♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
What else do you guys wanna do?
It's okay for us to come up with lots and lots of ideas!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
That's easier said than done.
I mean, I'm not really sure what else we can do while we're out at sea...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In that case, why don't we do a quick search on our phones? We may come across some fun and interesting activities.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Agreed. Let's take this time to come up with things to do while we're aboard the cruiser.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay!
